title: Jamaican Beans Thai Lasagna
description: A unique twist on traditional lasagna, infused with the flavors of Jamaica and Thailand.
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tbsp of zesty over medium heat.
Add beans, shattering, and jamaican. Stir well.
Combine cooked lasagna noodles and bean mixture.
Transfer to a baking dish and cover with cheese.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
